# 🚨 Crisis Contract

> **A Minecraft hardcore challenge mod inspired by Arknights' Contingency Contract system, deeply integrated with Phayriosis Parasite Infection!**

![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-1.20.1-00AF5C?style=flat-square)
![Forge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Forge-47.4.20-orange?style=flat-square)
![Phayriosis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Phayriosis-0.3.2.3-red?style=flat-square)

---

## 📖 Introduction

**Crisis Contract** brings Arknights' Contingency Contract challenge system into Minecraft. Before starting the game, you can choose from **20 deeply customized Phayriosis-themed tags** and activate different levels of difficulty modifiers. All effects take effect in real time, dramatically increasing the threat of Phayriosis Parasite Infection — and your goal is simple: **defeat the Ender Dragon**!

After each challenge, the system calculates a **total score** based on the contract levels you selected, pushing your limits!

> 🧪 **This mod is developed by Bilibili user PaOJiaoWeiPaOJiao**. Feedback and suggestions are welcome!

---

## 🎮 How to Play

1. Enter a world → **the contract selection screen pops up automatically** (or use `/crisis_contract open`)
2. Click a tag on the left to **cycle through levels** (Off → Lv1 → Lv2 → Lv3)
3. Confirm the **total score** and click "Start Challenge"
4. The Phayriosis parasite threat across the entire world will be **fully upgraded** based on your selections
5. **Defeat the Ender Dragon** → a results screen pops up, showing your total score and contract details

### Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|------|------|------|
| `/crisis_contract open` | Everyone | Opens the contract selection screen |
| `/crisis_contract start` | OP | Starts the challenge |
| `/crisis_contract status` | Everyone | Views the current challenge status |
| `/crisis_contract reset` | OP | Resets challenge data |

---

## 📜 20 Contract Tags

All tags are designed around the core mechanics of **Phayriosis Parasite Infection**, divided into 5 categories:

### 🔴 A — Phase & Infection
| Tag | Lv1 | Lv2 | Lv3 |
|------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Phase Leap** — Raises starting phase | +15 | +30 | +50 |
| **Accelerated Accumulation** — Point gain boosted | +10 | +20 | +35 |
| **Corruption Spread** — Block infection accelerated | +15 | +30 | +45 |
| **Resurrection** — Corpse evolution accelerated | +10 | +25 | +40 |
| **Nest Awakening** — Nest willpower strengthened | +15 | +35 | +55 |

### 🟠 B — Parasite Enhancement
| Tag | Lv1 | Lv2 | Lv3 |
|------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Hardened Carapace** — Parasites gain bonus armor | +10 | +25 | — |
| **Bloodlust Instinct** — Attack/movement speed boost | +10 | +20 | +35 |
| **Elite Bloodline** — Higher-tier variants spawn | +15 | +30 | +50 |
| **Adaptive Evolution** — Adaptation unlock accelerated | +15 | +30 | +45 |
| **Sonic Resonance** — Sonic blast damage doubled | +15 | +30 | — |

### 🟡 C — Player Debuffs
| Tag | Lv1 | Lv2 | Lv3 |
|------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Immune Deficiency** — Infection resistance reduced | +10 | +20 | +35 |
| **Radiation Vulnerability** — Radiation accumulation accelerated | +15 | +25 | +40 |
| **Fragile Flesh** — Incoming damage increased | +10 | +20 | +35 |
| **Soul Stripped** — Maximum health reduced | +15 | +30 | — |
| **Resource Depletion** — Healing/food effectiveness reduced | +10 | +20 | +30 |

### 🟢 D — Environmental Deterioration
| Tag | Lv1 | Lv2 | Lv3 |
|------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Eternal Night** — Light level decreased | +10 | +20 | — |
| **Ecosystem Collapse** — Parasite biome spreads | +15 | +35 | — |
| **Spore Miasma** — Persistent negative effects | +10 | +25 | +45 |

### ⚪ E — Tactical Restrictions
| Tag | Lv1 | Lv2 | Lv3 |
|------|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| **Tech Lockdown** — Tech equipment restricted | +15 | +25 | +45 |
| **Desperate Survival** — Hardcore survival restrictions | +15 | +10 | +35 |

> 💡 Some tags require further adaptation of the **Phayriosis API** to fully function. Core features (commands, GUI, contract selection, world setup) are all complete.

---

## 🎬 Visual Effects

- 🩸 **Dark Red Edge Overlay** — During a challenge, the screen edges fade to dark red, creating a tense atmosphere
- 🌪️ **Screen Shake** — Camera shakes when taking hits, enhancing impact feel
- 🔊 **Sound Feedback** — Ender Dragon roar at challenge start, totem sound at results
- 🖱️ **Hover Tooltips** — Hover over tags in the contract selection screen to view details

---

## 📋 Dependencies

| Mod | Version | Type |
|------|------|:----:|
| [Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/) | 1.20.1-47.4.20+ | **Required** |
| [Phayriosis Parasite Infection](https://modrinth.com/mod/phayriosis-parasite-infection) | 0.3.2.3 | **Required** |
| [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) | 4.x | Phayriosis dependency |
| [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) | Latest | Recommended |

---

## ⚙️ Installation

1. Install Forge 1.20.1-47.4.20+
2. Place this mod's jar file into the `mods` folder
3. Also add **Phayriosis Parasite Infection 0.3.2.3**
4. Launch the game — the **contract selection screen pops up automatically** when you enter a world!
